utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, the repair drive. What still needs doing, and where can I help? I’ve got a few tools and can come by today.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: That would help a lot. If you can bring the tools and handle whatever’s left in the back rooms, I’ll sort the list and meet you there.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Nell. If you hear any updates, send them my way so I can keep the house list and timing from drifting.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up too, but I’ll pass along anything I hear. Has the address list settled yet, or is that still being shuffled?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over a bit early to help with setup, and I’ll make sure everyone knows the time and place for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Vik. Could you help point people to the setup area and keep an eye on arrivals while I sort the supplies?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Just send me the first repair on the list and I’ll take it from there.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: I’ve got the first house ready for you. What time should I tell them you’ll be over?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: The repair drive is now Sunday at the community center, so send me any updates from your side and I’ll fold them in.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh good, I’ll pass that along. Last I heard, they were still collecting tools and supplies, and a few folks were planning to help sort everything Sunday afternoon.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Last I heard, they’re still gathering tools and supplies at the community hall, and a few folks are sorting things this afternoon. I’m still waiting on the exact schedule, though.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Okay, just send me the first repair when you have it and I’ll handle it.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Right, I can bring the tools and help set up the repair station today. Just point me at the first thing that needs doing.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That helps a lot. I’ll keep spreading the word and make sure everyone knows when and where to show up, and I’ll help get the station set up too.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details, so what’s the latest you’ve heard about when and where it’s happening?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: It’s still set for today at the community center, and I’m trying to get the repair station ready there. Could you bring the tools and help me sort the supplies when you arrive?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Sam. If you can bring your tools and help with the door latch, that would cover the main thing for today.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it. What time should I come by for the handoff?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Pia. Send what you have now, and I’ll slot in the two addresses and truck window as soon as they come through.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m still waiting on the truck window and one address confirmation, but I’ll send both as soon as they land.

injected.text: Update: the repair drive has been moved from Saturday at the front porch to Sunday at the community center.
